book.name: Tayaspatampanirini
book.title: Tayaspatampanirini Nuw Lukasi kamanchinllpa yuwaa Isus wámachtash tayaspatarangana anootsi

content: Mishat, yuwaa Papor yusur Masedonap naparangu anoo kamanchinllpa

Yuw Demítariy mantsir tsiyatarangana an pastaramchu, Papor Isuschichee ichinguru kuruzurangiya. Papor tsiyatarangu; Isusootsimari chinangtsa. Nuwma Masedonap tsap pangatama. Naanamachima. Taaraptsa; tárangiya. Táyaranllu, naatarangiya.

Papor arap Masedonash watsapun yaktap minush napta, minush napta asheemach ashirangiya. Papor Masedonshuchee Isuschich kuruzurangu, shaniyeersin, kapung tsiyateeru, Apanllee kuk kamanirangiya. Masedonashchee tsap shuneeyaranllu, kasarangiya. Yusur minush tsup Kiríkshuchipsha watsapun naatarangiya; anshurtatam tsap tayaspatarangiya. Anush Papor kuseeru,

tuchip tsup taarangiya Kiríkshuchshu. Sheeranllu, musap kitanlli Síriyap tsap naamchi átu, botish zarumaam zandarangiya. Zarumaam zandkachu, itaru Utaáshuch tputs: Paporoo pachayani atusin, anoo Papor mazinayaru, Musap watsta. Urupunguri naamchi; tárangiya. Masedonash watsapun napeenlluri, nuwaanpee Síriyap tsap kanapunlli; tárangiya.

Wipunashpa zapan naatarangana. Min Sopátiras suru Piros wipa, Bereyshuch tputsi. Mishat, Arístárku Tesalónshuchi tputsi. Mishat, Sekúndu Tesalónshuchitam tputsi. Mishat, Gayo Derbeshchi tputsi. Mishat, Tímoteyu, misha Tíkiku Ásiyshuch tputsi. Mishat, Torófimu suru Ásiyshuchtam tputsi. Ashipsin tsimbun matayaru wipunash naatarangana.
Ashiriya, Felipush yakat kuseersin, wipunashsha wasina botish zaruyarusin, Taráwtap yakat wasina naataranganaya. Anush, kutamanipa siyaama; táranganaya.

Itaru, Papor nuwapa Lukaspati Felipush yakat taarangani. Anush Utaáshucheem shambatshini kanatupshingamaam kutarangini. An shambatshini watach pangaa nda tputaru anoo katungkana anu. Sheeruni, iysha botish zaruyaruni, Taráwtap yakat naatarangini. Apus ipunpunaru maayaruni kítarangani. Sheeranlluni, kuseeruni, Taráwtash taarusin, Paporoo wipunash parangini, anshuri. Yuwaa Papor Masedonash tsap naparangu anoo kamaneena.
Mishat, yuwaa Yútiku íwar kuripungarangu anoo kamanchinllpa

Paporpat anush Taráwtash tsimbun matayaru maaranginiya. Ashiri putam zari, domingosh naachu, psaan Papor Isuschichpa shaniyaranginiya. Shaneeruni, Isus tsipachu ashirangu anoo yanischeeyani táyaruni, pangaa tatapta tatapta panata sheeruni, katungarangini. Paporsha Apanllee kuk kapung tayaspatarangiya. Kapung kamanku, schirsataa nda sambaytarangiya, watam putam naachuwa.
Pangusimun iwaz nambarin wazapan tirut tirut ashimasha anush shaniyarangini.

Kanungas Yútiku suru, anush wingunung kuxinarangiya. Itaru, maats ksumish kasirangiya. Maachir kis ashirangiya. Itaru, Papor tayaspatamaam nda kasaku, Yútiku wishchip kuripungarangiya. Yuwar asheets pangus wanupshi pantsarangiya. Tpuw taramach ashirangiya. Mishat, tputs mikeeru tit, karuwaranllu, itsirta sheeru, itaru Yútiku uru tsipama.
Paporsha karuweeru, Yútikumun kpumeeru, pachipurangiya. Apanllimun wizpuririni ituyamayaru, tputseetssha: Mangis matsarintspa; támeenlltanda,
tárangiya Paporo. Táyaru,

yusur waptam íwar kárirangu, Isuschichpat kis ipunaranginiya. Pangaa tatapi tatapi ashima ksari kapung katungarangana. Ksartari tsiyatstarusin, taraseeranginiya. Sheeruni, zar puturi Paporpa botip naataranganiya.
Tputs Yútikoo pangup wayaranganaya. Izuuru támarangiya; nda tsiparangiya. Isuschich ashirucha mang' ksaranganaya. Yuwaa Yútik kuripungarangu anoo kamaneena.
Mishat, yuwaa Papor Ipísup kuseeru Ipísshuchpa kapung tsiyatarangu anoo kamanchinllpa

Papor nuwaa tsiyatku, Shiy botish naangi. Nuw urupunguri naachima. Anush Ásush yakat chamayangamchinipa; tárangiya nuwaatsi. Nuwsha Ayu táyaruri, wipunashee ashpatam botish nuw machtarangina. Ásup yakat
kuseeruni, Paporoo chamayangarangina. Minush zar anush Paporpa zaruyaranlluni, Mítirinap yakat pakeeranlluni,
yusur Mítirinamand káyaruni, putam Kíyoo yakat tushiyrangini. Naaruni, putamsha Sámsush yakat matayeeruni, maarangini. Yusur putam káyaruni, Milétush yakat matayarangani.

Paporsha: Ipísup naamaam watsipari. Zapshtatpa. Mikeeruri naamchi; tárangiya. Utaáshuchee shambatshini Péntekóste suru anoo Irusarinshuri kanatupshingapi aturi, mikeeri naamchi; tárangiya. Ayu táyaruni,

Milétush kárirangani. Sheeruni, Ipísup Papor tputsee ksutamapaneetssin kuruzurangiya. Milétush kusangtsa mikeerus. Natum siyapa tsiyatpi watam kazurukachinawa, Papor áttanda táshinints; tárangiya Paporo.

Uwshtisin tsiyatssee mazinayarusin, mikeersin Paporosh kusaranganaya. Kuseersin Paporsha kapung tsiyatarangiya. Na mazinangints, tárangiya; Siy kapung nuwaa yasaktischa. Sirútama siyash kuseeruri, kapung nuwaa naparangsa. Tuchip yungandpas taaruri, ichinguru parangsa nuwaatsi.

Isus nuwaa tayaspatampaneem ínarangu, waa kuk uru payurangtana. Kiyung kachiyarangitaati, tanurangitaati, ashiritaa Isusoo kuk tayaspatamaam nda kasarangina. Utaáshuch tputs nuwaa wanipa kiyung yacharanganda.
Ashiritaa, kasarangeezi; ichinguru tayaspatarangina. Tputs wazapan shaniykusin, anush pshtuyaruri, tayaspatatarina. Siyash pangis napta napta ashiranguri, tayaspatarangina.
Tputsee ichinguru kamanirangina Utaáshucheetsi, misha arapcheetstamta. Yutaritshishee ksangtsa. Isusumunari mangis tatungtsa; uru, tárangina. Sambaytarangeezi.
Itaru, na Irusarinap naachima. Apanll Wani nuwaa machkandanaya. Anush kuskachuri, ¿Utaáshuch nuwaa tamachimasazinllinaja? Yasareezi, nuwa.

Yaktap napta napta ashiranguri, itaru Apanll Wani Isuschichee mang' p'tseerangu, nuwaa kapung kamaniranganaya. Papcha; Irusarinush kuskachush, shiyaa tumanachapanlla; shiyaa kiyung yachachpasinaya; Isuschich nuwaa átssincha.

Ashtaataparee, nuw Isusoo wamin tsipatsee punikeezi, watam Apanll waana nuwaa kamachtaranguwa. Itaru, nuw minamari chinakina Isusoo kuk izuuru kamanimaama. Sirú Isus nuwaa: K'keetsi kamanishini; Apanll tputsee kizpur chinakiya táshini; tárangiya. Ashiri kis kamanirangtana.
Ashirucha, nuw siyaa atashina; siyash kapung xiyrangitaati, kapungtam Apanllee kuk kamanirangitaati, itaru nuw siyaa yusur pangcheezi, ndambaree. Nduntaatiya tsipakuri, nuwaa pangcheezis, ndambaree.

Itaru, mazinangtsa; na ini tsiyatsis zurumamash kamanchintspa. Siyaa Apanllee kuk kamaniranguri, izuuru kamanirangtana. Kamapshirangeezi, dancha. Ashiri siy Isusoo ngatkinaareesa ashiru, Apanllish nda kamungatssa: saanapa yasatssa. Apanll nuwaa napchiya, watam itsinsaru kamaniranginawa.

Ashiri mangiptis taangtsa. Isuschichpatatis wanasir ksutangtsa, watam Apanll Wani siyaa ksutamapaneem ínaranguwa. Apanll Wani siyaa kamachtakitamta. Isuschichee waneengtsa; masattapa; átcha Apanll Wani. Ashiri shingtsa. Watam Isus waana ursirpatari iyamand yutaritshishirini tuwaparanguwa.
Na naakchuri, kushimuni yashingchich tputs kusachpasinaya. Isuschichee nda chinaksin, yutarit yaspatachpasinaya.
Siyashchi tputs ashpatam piyari chinayarusin, mantsir tayaspatachpasinaya. Nuwash tchitanda atusin, siyaa ashpatamtis waama wipunasheem ínachapantsa.

Yutaritshiship tchitusinapa aturi, siyaa waneekina. Yuwaa tayaspatarangi anoo chinangtsa; mbizarintspa. Tuchip yungandpas siyaa nda kasarangina. Psaantaa, kaschiritaat kaman kaman ashirangina. Wanipa siyangaz tanurangi.

Na Apanll siyaa napchiya. Apanll kuk kizpur siyaa istachintsa. Apanll kuk kizpurcha. Izuuru mangoonamaam istachapantsa. Ashkachu, waanaatsi tiptsiree ichinguru tapachindachu, siyaatstam izuuru istachitamparee wash kuskachus.
Nuw tputsingaz urkiri támararangeezi. Wamaringaz támararangitamtazi.
Kachis parangtischa nuwaatsi. Nuwaani tarawaztaranguri, anumun kchitarangina. Anumand ipunsheemi istarangitamti.

Ashirucha, siyaa wanasir taamaam tayaspatarangina. Tputsich ichingurutanda tarawaztakuch ancha wanasiri. Tarawaztakuch, tputsee yuwaam kiyung kachiyku anoom istakuch, ancha kizpur wanasiri, watam waana Isus atuwa: Tputs siyaam mangutari panaku, mangis ksamana ksachparee. Itaru, saana tputseem panakus, aranginasha kis taatssa; atimanda Isusu. Ashiri shingtsa, tárangiya Paporo.
Tsiyatssee iwapayaru, tutunlltayarusin, Apanllpa tsiyatarangana.
Tsiyateersin, ichingurusin Paporoo pachipeersin, kapung tanuranganaya.

Kizpur mang' mantsarangana Paporongzi. Yuwamand Papor: Nuwaa yusur pangcheezis, ndambaree: kazurakchima; tárangu anungaz tanurangana. Sheersin, macheetusin Paporoo botish wayaranganaya. Sheeruni, zaruranginiya. Yuwaa Papor Ipísshuchee kazurakchima, tárangu anoo kamaneena.

footnotes.text: 1 Utaáchich kuraka 17.21 tsiyatsis nipta tatsamooru taaritamta.
